IUPAC's registered record places the current known element boundary at oganesson, Z=118; reports superheavy Z≥104 production by heavy-ion fusion and identification through implanted-residue decay chains with alpha decay and/or spontaneous fission; and NIST records one-electron E1 orbital change by one rank. These externally correspond to the frozen synthesis, decay and spectroscopy classes but do not observe Smithium, select a unique production route, or supply its lifetime, branch fractions or wavelengths. Smithium remains a precise standing prediction.
